📰 General

Hilary Duff Reveals New Album Title & February Release Date •

Singer Hilary Duff will release her sixth studio album, titled “Luck…or Something,” on February 20th through Atlantic Records. The announcement marks the first new music from Duff in a decade. The project’s initial single, “Mature,” was previously released as a promotional preview. Duff’s label confirmed the album’s upcoming release date following a series of teasers.

🌍 World

Starmer Urges Voters to Judge Him at the Next General Election •

Labour leader Sir Keir Starmer stated that significant progress requires time and intends to be evaluated by the public at the upcoming general election. He acknowledged his government’s recent “good steps” in addressing the cost-of-living crisis. Starmer emphasized the need for continued effort to transform the nation’s trajectory. The Labour leader’s comments reflect a strategy focused on demonstrating tangible results before seeking a mandate from voters.

🦅 US

Grizzly Bear Attacks Students and Teachers in Remote Canadian Community •

A grizzly bear attacked a group of students and teachers in a remote area of British Columbia’s Central Coast on Thursday. The incident occurred within a school setting, resulting in multiple injuries to those involved. Local authorities, including police and conservation officials, responded to the attack. Initial reports indicate several students and teachers sustained injuries during the encounter. Investigations into the circumstances surrounding the attack are currently underway.

💰 Business

Dept. of Transportation Launches Campaign Promoting Civility on Flights •

The U.S. Department of Transportation announced a new initiative designed to improve passenger behavior during air travel. The campaign encourages travelers to demonstrate courtesy by adhering to respectful attire and utilizing polite phrases like “please” and “thank you.” The department cited concerns about a decline in civility and a desire to restore a positive atmosphere for both passengers and airline staff. This effort follows a recent survey indicating passenger dissatisfaction with the level of respect shown on flights.

💻 Technology

Black Ops 7 Developers Confirm Aim Assist & SMG Improvements Are Incoming •

Treyarch has confirmed upcoming adjustments to Black Ops 7’s multiplayer experience. The developers are implementing significant buffs to aim assist, intended to improve gun control for players. Specifically, the SMG category is receiving substantial improvements as part of this update. These changes follow initial positive reception of the multiplayer component despite criticism of the campaign.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya attended the 2024 Met Gala in a breathtaking custom Valentino gown designed by Pierpaolo Piccioli. The dress featured a voluminous, sculpted silhouette with intricate floral embellishments and a dramatic train. The actress accessorized with Tiffany & Co. jewelry and a stunning Bulgari Serpenti bracelet. Photographers captured numerous images of Zendaya’s striking appearance at the event, which celebrated Karl Lagerfeld’s legacy.

🏅 Sports

Penguins Return Home, Secure Series Win Against Predators, Prepare for Wild •

The Pittsburgh Penguins defeated the Nashville Predators 20-1 in a decisive home game, marking their return from a recent Global Series trip. The Penguins secured three of four possible points during the series, demonstrating strong offensive performance. Friday’s game against the Minnesota Wild will kick off the remainder of the regular season for the team. The Penguins’ lines saw adjustments, and both goaltenders played key roles in the victory.

🔬 Science

Scientists Discover First Kiss Recorded in Fossilized Primate Remains •

A new study published in the journal Nature details the discovery of fossilized primate remains suggesting the earliest instances of kissing occurred approximately 20 million years ago. Researchers analyzed teeth from extinct primates, identifying evidence of close-contact behavior and dental abrasion patterns consistent with grooming and potential affectionate interactions. This suggests that kissing, in its most basic form, originated in the ancestors of modern great apes. The findings provide a significant step in understanding the evolution of social bonding and communication within primate species.

🩺 Health

Measles Cases Surge in Upstate South Carolina, Linked to Multiple Locations •

The Upstate of South Carolina has now confirmed over 50 cases of measles, according to the South Carolina Department of Public Health. Two of the newly identified cases are connected to individuals residing within the same households as previously confirmed cases. Health officials are investigating the outbreak, focusing on identifying potential exposure sites. The investigation is ongoing, and public health officials are urging individuals with symptoms to seek medical attention and inform their healthcare providers.
